task_description: Redesign the UI of Site1 (site1/ static HTML+CSS profile) so it reads as mature and executive-grade instead of childish/playful, per user complaint (GitHub issue #5). Overhaul palette, typography, motion, iconography/emojis, and surface shapes while preserving all textual content and keeping the site pure HTML+CSS (no JS/frameworks), responsive, with working CSS-only dark mode and mobile nav. Work on branch fix/site1-mature-redesign; orchestrator handles push/PR.

All textual content preserved (name, all stats 12+/35K+/518/5, all testimonial authors, all 4 project hrefs, #GivetoGain, Women In Tech Workshop). Inspected :root + dark-mode blocks: coherent restrained steel-blue/ink editorial palette with a correct matching dark variant. docker_build skipped (no Dockerfile; INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network).
